title: A cancelled train
instructionsHu: Angliában utazol, és törölték a vonatodat. Menj oda az információs pulthoz, mondd el a problémát, és tudd meg, hogyan juthatsz el a célodhoz. Minden pontot teljesíts.

situation.context: You are travelling alone from Manchester to London, where your aunt is going to meet you at the station. At Manchester Piccadilly station you see on the board that your train has been cancelled. You go to the information desk.
situation.candidateRole: You are a passenger whose train has been cancelled.
situation.examinerRole: The examiner is the assistant at the information desk.
goals: Ask when the next train to London leaves and from which platform.
Find out if your ticket is valid on that train or if you have to pay extra.
Ask where you can get something to eat while you are waiting.

followUpQuestions: I'm sorry about that. Can I see your ticket, please?
The next one leaves at a quarter to four from platform six, but it's a slower train. It arrives in London at half past six. Is that all right for you?
Is there anything else you need to know?

usefulPhrases.en: My train to London has been cancelled.
When does the next train leave?
Which platform does it leave from?
Do I have to pay extra?
Is there a café in the station?
Someone is waiting for me in London.
